for ln in names:

        s = sp[links == ln]
        loc = (Tinv[:3,:3] @ s[:, :3].T).T + Tinv[:3,3]
        print(ln, "n", len(s), "in TCP frame: x[%.3f,%.3f] y[%.3f,%.3f] z[%.3f,%.3f] r[%.3f,%.3f]" % (
            loc[:,0].min(), loc[:,0].max(), loc[:,1].min(), loc[:,1].max(), loc[:,2].min(), loc[:,2].max(), s[:,3].min(), s[:,3].max()))

objs = ep.reperceive()
for o in objs:
    if np.hypot(o.centroid[0]-PC[0], o.centroid[1]-PC[1]) < 0.15:
        print(o.id, o.label, o.centroid.round(4), "bot", round(o.bottom_z,4), "top", round(o.top_z,4), "aabb", np.round(o.aabb,4).tolist())

m = rh.points_in(xyz, aabb=[[PC[0]-0.10, PC[1]-0.10, 0.015], [PC[0]+0.10, PC[1]+0.10, 0.08]])
b = xyz[m]; cc = np.asarray(ci)[m]
print("bowl pts above 1.5cm:", len(b), "per cam", np.bincount(cc), "zmax", b[:,2].max().round(4))
top = b[b[:,2] > b[:,2].max() - 0.006]
cx, cy, r = rh.fit_circle(top[:, :2])
print(f"rim circle: c=({cx:.4f},{cy:.4f}) r={r:.4f}  offset from plate c: ({cx-PC[0]:+.4f},{cy-PC[1]:+.4f}) |d|={np.hypot(cx-PC[0],cy-PC[1]):.4f}")
# outer edge approach
ang = np.arctan2(b[:,1]-cy, b[:,0]-cx); dd = np.hypot(b[:,0]-cx, b[:,1]-cy)
bins = np.linspace(-np.pi, np.pi, 25); edge=[]; zs=[]
for a0, a1 in zip(bins[:-1], bins[1:]):
    mm = (ang >= a0) & (ang < a1)
    if mm.sum() > 5:
        i = np.argmax(np.where(mm, dd, -1)); edge.append(b[i,:2]); zs.append(b[i,2])
edge = np.array(edge); ecx, ecy, er = rh.fit_circle(edge)
print(f"outer edge circle: c=({ecx:.4f},{ecy:.4f}) r={er:.4f} offset ({ecx-PC[0]:+.4f},{ecy-PC[1]:+.4f}) |d|={np.hypot(ecx-PC[0],ecy-PC[1]):.4f}")
# rim height by direction (tilt check): max z per angular sector
for a0, a1 in zip(np.linspace(-np.pi, np.pi, 9)[:-1], np.linspace(-np.pi, np.pi, 9)[1:]):
    mm = (ang >= a0) & (ang < a1) & (dd > 0.04)
    if mm.sum():
        print(f"  sector {np.degrees(a0):+5.0f}..{np.degrees(a1):+5.0f}: rim max z {b[mm,2].max():.4f}  n {mm.sum()}")
